title: prefill/decode pipeline: chunked speculative prefill and stage overlap optimizations
author: Jordan Kim
description: This PR implements a combined set of runtime optimizations that reduce tail latency and improve GPU utilization by enabling chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage overlap between prefill and decode stages. Motivation: many real workloads mix short interactive messages with long context windows; a monolithic prefill phase creates latency spikes and underutilized decode kernels. Summary of changes: 1) Chunked prefill scheduler: splits long prefill requests into fixed-size chunks and schedules them as soon as their KV shards are available so downstream decode can start earlier. 2) Speculative prefill: a lightweight estimator warms KV cache for likely token prefixes and allows decoding to speculatively start on top-K hypotheses when appropriate. 3) Stage overlap: runtime execution now supports overlapping prefill and decode on different GPU queues and model partitions with an explicit handoff protocol. 4) Kernel selection tweaks: prefer fused attention kernels for prefill-dominated workloads and fall back to lower-latency decode kernels when overlap is active. 5) New runtime flags and model profile config knobs (continuous_batching.enabled, prefill.chunk_size, prefill.speculation_threshold, overlap.max_concurrent_prefills) with safe defaults and per-model rollout. 6) KV cache correctness: added cache versioning checks and serialization compatibility to ensure safe rollout and recoverability. Benchmarks: internal perf harness on representative chat workloads shows 18-28% throughput improvement (tokens/sec) and 12-35% reduction in 95th percentile latency across T4 and A100 clusters for mixed short/long sequences. Rollout plan: feature gated and disabled by default for existing production profiles; gradual enablement via config and can be scoped per model/tag. Testing: end-to-end perf tests, unit tests for scheduler logic, race-condition fuzzing for KV handoff, and updated integration tests. Linked design doc in Linear (ENG-4821) covers details and microbench plots. Backwards compatibility: no protocol changes required for clients; KV cache format remains compatible and guarded behind version checks. See files changed for implementation and perf harness updates.

fea: implement speculative prefill estimator and warm paths
perf: enable stage overlap runtime handoff and queueing

review_comments: Priya Nair: Overall looks good — the chunking scheduler addresses the long-tail issue we saw in the canary. Please add a doc snippet describing the rollback procedure if cache mismatch happens.
Jordan Kim (author): Added cache versioning and a migration-safe fallback; documented rollback in runtime_config.yaml and docs/perf/prefill_decode_optimizations.md

Daniel Ortega: Found a potential race in the handoff path where prefill shards can be released before decode has consumed the KV. Suggested adding a short grace period and added a unit test to cover it.
Jordan Kim (author): Added grace period logic and a unit test (prefill_handoff_grace_period). CI initially failed on flakiness in the fuzz harness, reran and green.
Marta Ivanov: Benchmarks look convincing for A100; request to run a smaller-scale test on older GPU types (V100/T4) — results included in the perf harness updates.
Sam Liu: Approving after small nits (naming and doc clarifications) were addressed. Marking for squash-merge.
CI: perf-workflow reported a transient regression on one benchmark during first run; rerun passed and the final green run showed improvements quoted in the description.
release_notes: Optimizes prefill/decode pipeline via chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage overlap to improve throughput and reduce tail latency. Feature is behind runtime flags and can be rolled out per-model.
